name: Puddles!
description: Shaken, not... spilled? Adds puddles to several thrown items. Water and wine (electricity), alcohol (flammable) and soda (slippery).

options.name: Water
options.tooltip: Water pools from Atlantide bottle, martini shaker, and snow globe

options.name: Vodka
options.tooltip: Makes vodka and whiskey bottles spill flammable alcohol

options.name: Vodka (Quest items)
options.tooltip: Makes quest item vodka bottles throwable and create flammable puddles. Buggy, free throwing and dropping don't work properly atm.

options.name: Wine
options.tooltip: Throwing wine bottles creates pools of wine that can electrocute like water

options.name: Soda
options.tooltip: Throwing soda cans creates slippery puddles of soda

options.name: Unlockables
options.tooltip: Adds Atlantide water bottle, soda can and vodka bottles to loadout screen
